milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining a polished granite slab with a pickaxe causes the item to drop and enter the player's inventory. The player starts with no polished_granite_slab in inventory (only an iron_pickaxe), so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks per the design philosophy — it directly reflects the task outcome rather than relying on position or event counters.
